claims.claim: The asset has the requested identity, rigid structure, and single mesh collision.
claims.evidence: asset/asset.json: id apple_01, kind rigid; asset/provenance.json: Objaverse UID 50ffb91434ea4d978eaefe03220d36fe. asset/model.urdf has one base_link, mass 0.0600677 kg, no joints, and one collision referencing collision.obj.

claims.claim: The apple fits within the stated 8 cm gripper opening.
claims.evidence: probes/01_settle.out: collision bounds [-0.030782,-0.034101,-0.032986] to [0.036285,0.033452,0.032379] m, giving dimensions 6.707 x 6.755 x 6.537 cm. Renders show an exposed body reachable from above; both horizontal dimensions are below 8 cm. This establishes geometric fit, not a simulated grasp.

claims.claim: Collision geometry closely follows the visible apple.
claims.evidence: probes/01_settle.out: 4999 collision faces; sampled visual-to-collision surface distances p95 0.295 mm, maximum 1.084 mm; collision-to-visual p95 0.182 mm, maximum 0.391 mm. Visual and collision bounds agree within 0.064 mm per bound. renders/front.png, side.png, top.png, and iso.png show a solid apple with no required interior access.

claims.claim: Joint travel, attachment, and inter-link penetration checks do not apply.
claims.evidence: readings.json joints is empty; asset/model.urdf contains only base_link and no joints or other links.

claims.claim: Handle grasp and pull checks do not apply.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no handles; readings.json handles is empty.

claims.claim: Place-target support checks do not apply.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no place targets; readings.json place_targets is empty.

claims.claim: The free rigid body settles and remains stable in its supplied pose.
claims.evidence: probes/01_settle.out: initialized fixed=False at z=0.032986 m using the lowest collision vertex. At frames 150 and 300 (5 and 10 seconds), position is [0.00064,0.00333,0.03237] m and rotation is unchanged to printed precision; tilt from initial +Z is 5.935 degrees. Ground contact forces total 0.589 N, consistent with its weight.

claims.claim: The supplied asset pose represents an upright apple as required for placement.
claims.evidence: renders/front.png and renders/iso.png show the stem cavity facing sideways; renders/side.png and renders/top.png show the stem projecting laterally instead of upward along +Z. The stable pose in probes/01_settle.out rotates only 5.935 degrees from the supplied orientation, so settling does not correct this sideways orientation.

metrics.feedback: Rotate the visual and collision meshes together so the apple rests on its blossom/base end with its stem pointing upward along +Z in the default asset pose. Update the inertial frame as needed, regenerate the renders and readings, and rerun the free-body ground settling check at z=-z_min to verify that the corrected upright pose remains stable. Preserve the current gripper-compatible size and close visual/collision agreement.
